verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core abstractions (autonomous Agents, Crews, Flows) plus CLI run commands and CrewAI Enterprise's managed-infrastructure deployment with webhook streaming let users define and execute multi-agent automations that run without manual intervention, including in production/background contexts. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron-trigger documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of long-running unattended background jobs, and clarity on how failures/retries are handled in unattended runs.
